utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks — once you’ve got the tool list, I can swing by and help fill in whatever’s missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’ll get the tool list together and keep it simple for now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still a bit foggy on the exact list, but I think it was mostly the gate and a couple of lane markers. What time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can do a quick evening run—what time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s definitely happening, and the main update is that it’s now Sunday at the community center. I’m still pulling together the rest of the details, but that’s the latest for now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what does the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m checking what tools we’re still missing for the repair drive, and I’ll let you know as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — I’m still catching up on the repair drive details, but I know it’s Sunday at the community center. If you need a hand, I can help keep things simple.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye — Sunday at the community center helps a lot. If you remember the first repair spot, could you point me there?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help—just tell me the plan for the repair drive and what time you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for sure — I’m just pulling the final details together. I’ll let you know the time and what you can help with as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — Saturday morning works for me. I’ll spread the word and see who else wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday morning with my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which parts still need repair on the drive? I want to check the details before I pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking the list now, and I’ll let you know which parts still need repair for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll keep spreading the word and loop in anyone who wants to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn — that helps. I’ll send the plan as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday morning at the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — I’m still catching up, but I heard the community center on Maple is the place to be Saturday morning. Let me know if there’s anything I should check first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s definitely happening — just send me the first stop’s tool list and I’ll bring what we need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great — thanks, Gus. What’s the first stop’s tool list?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’m still planning on Saturday morning at the community center on Maple, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll keep the community center on Maple as the first repair drive spot and note any changes you send my way.
